items.name: Modern Web Guidance
items.summary: A knowledge base maintained by the Chrome team that keeps coding agents up to date with the latest web best practices.

items.name: ECC
items.summary: An agent harness performance optimization system: skills, memory and security tuned to make coding agents run better.

items.name: Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work: 82 skills with commands covering the hunt workflow.

items.name: Open Code Review
items.summary: Alibaba's open-source code review tool: a hybrid of deterministic pipelines and an LLM agent producing precise line-level comments, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale.

items.name: Anthropic Skills
items.summary: Anthropic's public repository for Agent Skills: skills built on the open Agent Skills standard, ready for Claude and other agents to load.

items.name: OpenMausBot
items.summary: An open-source alternative to Grok Bot: gives bots a virtual machine they can operate to carry out computer tasks.

items.name: LoopForge
items.summary: Tencent's self-hosted workflow orchestration for coding-agent delivery: coordinates CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates.

items.name: Daily Stock Analysis
items.summary: An LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system: multi-source quotes, real-time news, a decision dashboard and automatic push, runnable on a zero-cost schedule.

items.name: Agent Skills
items.summary: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents: senior-engineering workflows packaged as skills agents can call directly.

items.name: Plannotator
items.summary: A workspace for staying in the loop with your agents: shape, decide, plan, annotate and review code, then send all feedback back to the agent in one click.
